name: Rheumatism-root
desc: Rheumatism-root (Jeffersonia diphylla): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 28 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Jeffersonia, also known as twinleaf or rheumatism root, is a small genus of herbaceous perennial plants in the family Berberidaceae. The only species is Jeffersonia diphylla.
